profile.description: Oman Arab Bank SAOG engages in the commercial and investment banking activities in the Sultanate of Oman. It operates through Retail Banking, Corporate Banking, Treasury, Others, and Islamic Banking segments. The company offers deposit products, including current, minor, savings, growth, fixed deposit, youth, and upfront deposit interest accounts; and loan products, such as home, car, and personal loans. It also provides credit, debit, prepaid, corporate, and reward cards, as well as merchant services and card promotions; ATM, and internet and mobile banking services; and bancassurance products comprising motor, travel, health, home contents, and comprehensive personal insurances. In addition, the company offers treasury services that include spot foreign exchange, foreign exchange and money market, and hedging services; trade and project finance; and cash management services. Further, it provides Sharia’ compliant Islamic banking products and services, such as Ijarah, Murabaha, Mudarbah, and Diminishing Musharakah. Oman Arab Bank SAOG was founded in 1973 and is headquartered in Muscat, the Sultanate of Oman.
